## Scope

The audit covered 320 second reads taken this quarter. The review examined the consistency of grading across the audit sample and provided an overall measure of agreement. Results are intended to support routine quality assurance and identify areas where further review or discussion may be helpful. The findings apply to the reads included in the audit and should be considered in that context.

## Result

Overall agreement was 66.9 per cent. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet for review. These results will be discussed with each grader privately, allowing the findings to be considered in context and any relevant points to be followed up appropriately. The overall result and the supporting per-grader information should be used together when reviewing performance and planning any further quality work.
